PdfOverlay — portable Windows app
=================================

What this is
------------
A local-only PDF page overlay tool. It runs from this folder. No installer.

How to run
----------
1. Get approval from your company IT/security team before using this on a
   company computer (including remote desktop / Citrix / VDI sessions).
2. Copy this entire folder somewhere you can run programs from, for example:
     - a folder on the work PC, or
     - a USB drive
4. Double-click PdfOverlay.exe
5. Open two local PDFs, pick pages, adjust opacity/alignment.

What you can do
---------------
- Overlay two PDF pages with opacity
- Nudge / scale the top page for alignment
- Zoom the view for inspection
- Export / import a project file (settings only; PDFs are not copied)
- Choose the temporary folder and clear temporary data

Sharing with a colleague (USB)
------------------------------
1. Copy this whole folder onto a USB drive (not just PdfOverlay.exe).
2. Give them the USB drive or a zip of this folder.
3. They still need their own IT approval before using it on a company PC.
4. They copy the folder onto their approved machine (or run from the USB if
   their IT allows that), then run PdfOverlay.exe.

Important privacy points
------------------------
- Does not upload PDFs or talk to the internet for app features.
- Does not install services, drivers, or browser extensions.
- Does not require admin rights.
- Does not modify the original PDF files.
- Temporary files stay in a "temp" folder beside this app (or a fallback you
  can choose). Use "Clear Temporary Data" anytime; temp is also cleared on exit.
